title: Point the WhatsApp sync worker at the desktop store + run it under persistent launchd
scope:
This branch is based on wa-bridge-capture, where the desktop bridge now captures messages into app_data_dir/whatsapp/whatsapp.db in a `messages`/`chats` table matching the lharries schema. Make the sync worker run persistently and read the RIGHT database.

DO:
1. tools/whatsapp-sync/sync.mjs: change default WHATSAPP_DB_PATH (currently ~/whatsapp-mcp/whatsapp-bridge/store/messages.db at ~sync.mjs:41-43) to ~/Library/Application Support/io.hyperpolymath.jarvis-desktop/whatsapp/whatsapp.db. Keep env-overridable. Verify the SELECT (~sync.mjs:79-91: messages.content, is_from_me, timestamp; join chats.name) matches the capture schema the bridge now writes (read tools/whatsapp-bridge/main.go in this branch to confirm the exact table/column names); adjust the query only if needed.
2. Add a launchd plist tools/whatsapp-sync/com.hyperpolymath.whatsapp-sync.plist (RunAtLoad + KeepAlive, JARVIS_APP_URL + JARVIS_DEVICE_TOKEN env vars), per the README template. For local dev JARVIS_APP_URL is http://localhost:3000. Document loading it in the README.
3. Register the sync worker in tools/hyperpolymath/hyperpolymath.mjs SERVICES array so it comes up with the stack (follow the existing service entry pattern).
4. Update tools/whatsapp-sync/README.md: desktop store canonical; the standalone lharries bridge is RETIRED (Option A, fresh-from-now, no backfill).

Do NOT change the ingest route or whatsapp_messages schema.
criteria: sync.mjs defaults to the desktop bridge store path, still env-overridable, and its SELECT matches the capture schema written by tools/whatsapp-bridge/main.go on this branch.
A launchd plist (RunAtLoad + KeepAlive) exists so the worker runs persistently; README documents loading it.
The sync worker is registered in tools/hyperpolymath/hyperpolymath.mjs SERVICES so it starts with the stack.
README updated: desktop store canonical, lharries retired.
